#Peysoh & The Homies Got Stranded In Oregon After Running Out Of Gas On The Way To Seattle For Their Next Tour Stop With Bravo The Bagchaser 😭⛽️

Tee Mo’Money Ran 3 Miles Uphill To Grab Gas & Get The Crew Back On The Road 🏃‍♂️💨

Peysoh is a Mexican-American rapper from Maywood, California, who became known for his raw West Coast sound and autobiographical storytelling. Born December 23, 2003, he first gained major attention as a teenager with his 2020 breakout track “6 Block,” which reflected on his upbringing and environment in Maywood. He later built his catalog with projects including Ghetto Journal and Get Rich or Life Sliding, while working closely with artists such as MoneySign Suede and Swifty Blue. 

Peysoh reached a much wider audience in 2024 when Kendrick Lamar featured him on “GNX,” the title track from Kendrick’s album. The appearance helped introduce Peysoh and the newer Los Angeles Latino rap scene to a mainstream audience. He has continued releasing music since then, including the 2026 album BastardChild. 

His music is especially known for straightforward storytelling about his experiences, struggles, loyalty, and life around Los Angeles, making him one of the recognizable younger voices in modern West Coast rap.
